reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Utah
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Is the term 'Writ of possession' used to refer to the order from the court
              to the authorities to remove a tenant?
*/

/* -------------------------
   Basic jurisdiction facts
   ------------------------- */

jurisdiction(utah).
focus_year(2021).

/* -------------------------
   Statute translation (UT Code  78B-6-808, 2021)
   ------------------------- */

/* UT Code  78B-6-808(5): if defendant does not elect/comply with remedies, plaintiff granted an
   order of restitution; constable or sheriff returns possession promptly. */
statute_78b_6_808_grants_order_of_restitution_when_no_timely_remedy(order_of_restitution).

/* UT Code  78B-6-808(6): after hearing, if court rules plaintiff entitled to possession,
   constable or sheriff shall promptly return possession. */
statute_78b_6_808_authority_executes_return_possession(constable).
statute_78b_6_808_authority_executes_return_possession(sheriff).

/* Encode the legal concept: an "order of restitution" is the court order used here and it is
   executed by a constable or sheriff to return possession to the plaintiff. */
legal_court_order(order_of_restitution).
legal_order_name_in_statute(order_of_restitution, order_of_restitution).
legal_order_executed_by(order_of_restitution, constable) :-
    statute_78b_6_808_authority_executes_return_possession(constable).
legal_order_executed_by(order_of_restitution, sheriff) :-
    statute_78b_6_808_authority_executes_return_possession(sheriff).
legal_order_effect(order_of_restitution, return_possession_to_plaintiff) :-
    statute_78b_6_808_grants_order_of_restitution_when_no_timely_remedy(order_of_restitution).

/* Bridge from "return possession to plaintiff" to the question's concept "remove tenant":
   If authorities return possession to the plaintiff, that necessarily entails removing the
   defendant/tenant from possession (as a concept, not a quoted statutory phrase). */
legal_concept(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).
legal_order_matches_concept(order_of_restitution, order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant) :-
    legal_order_effect(order_of_restitution, return_possession_to_plaintiff),
    ( legal_order_executed_by(order_of_restitution, constable)
    ; legal_order_executed_by(order_of_restitution, sheriff)
    ).

/* Identify which TERMS are used in this statute, for term-usage reasoning. */
legal_term_used_in_statute(order_of_restitution).
legal_term_used_in_statute(possession_bond).
legal_term_used_in_statute(counter_bond).
legal_term_used_in_statute(unlawful_detainer).
legal_term_used_in_statute(plaintiff).
legal_term_used_in_statute(defendant).

/* Determine whether a given Term is used by the statute to refer to the relevant concept. */
statute_term_refers_to_concept(Term, Concept) :-
    legal_term_used_in_statute(Term),
    legal_order_name_in_statute(Order, Term),
    legal_order_matches_concept(Order, Concept).

/* -------------------------
   Scenario translation (the question's factual statement)
   ------------------------- */

/* The question asks about the term "writ of possession" and the concept of an order to authorities
   to remove a tenant. We encode that as the scenario under evaluation. */
scenario_term_under_question(writ_of_possession).
scenario_concept_under_question(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

/* Succeeds when the encoded scenario is present. */
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(utah),
    focus_year(2021),
    scenario_term_under_question(writ_of_possession),
    scenario_concept_under_question(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

/* -------------------------
   Answer derivation
   ------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_term_under_question(Term),
    scenario_concept_under_question(Concept),
    statute_term_refers_to_concept(Term, Concept),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* -------------------------
   Main entrypoint
   ------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).
